name: Objaverse-XL: A Universe of 10M+ 3D Objects
description: Objaverse-XL is a colossal open dataset containing over 10 million 3D objects, representing more than an order of magnitude increase in scale over previous 3D corpora. Created by AI2 and the University of Washington, it aggregates diverse 3D meshes, CAD models, photogrammetry scans, and architectural models from across the web with aligned textual descriptions, unlocking unprecedented scale for 3D foundation models.
